data.restriction:
Any resident of the European Economic Area or Switzerland can register a .YT.

Note: in the event that there is a restricted domain name available, you must indicate the reason why you deserve to have the domain, and confirm that you are going to use it in good faith. Once your order has been made, it will end in an error, and you must then contact our customer support with your justification for use, so that they can request that it be unblocked by the registry.

Gandi offers a 1 year standard certificate, even if you don't want to be hosted by us.

Extension Requirements
The .app extension is on Google's HSTS preload list, meaning that HTTPS is required for all .app websites and pages.
To work properly in browsers, you will need to obtain an SSL certificate and configure the HTTPS serving. Learn more about SSL certificates at Gandi.

To register a .AR domain, you

  • must have a postal address in Argentina

You may contact our Gandi Corporate Team who can offer you a solution to having a local contact.



Opening of .AR second level domain names:
- A Landrush phase will run from November 25th 2019 to January 23rd 2020. During this phase, domain names are not allocated under the first come first served basis, they are allocated at the end of the Landrush phase. If several applicants have requested the same domain name, a draw will assign the domain name. In case the domain name is not allocated to you, you will be not entitled to receive any refund. All registration requests made between these dates will be subject to Landrush phase.
- The general opening will occur February 23rd 2020. At this time domain names will be available under the first come first served basis. All registration requests made between the end of the Landrush and the beginning of the general opening, will be stored and sent to the Registry only at the time of the beginning of the general opening.

To register a .tn domain name, you must meet the following registry conditions:

  • If the domain name does not correspond to the name of the person registering the domain, the domain name must then correspond to a Tunisian trademark, and
  • a local administrative contact is required if a valid Tunisian trademark is not provided.

If you do not not have a local presence, Gandi can provide you with one if you subscribe to our Trustee service.
